verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an open-source memory layer with a CLI, SDKs and a hosted service, but nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking switch. Self-hosting to keep data on your own infrastructure and opt-in Dreamer features are related but different controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
